mechanism_narrative: The joint contraction of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES over the last four weeks removes commuting and workplace-adjacent footfall, and with no recovery threshold, this drag lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds last 28-day mean while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain below -30.

mechanism_narrative: The collapse of GROCERY_PHARM from +34.3 to +1.1 marks the end of stock-up trips; as grocery hoarding unwinds, households redirect some trips to retail-and-recreation, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below +5.0 after exceeding +15.0 in the prior two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than last 28-day mean despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining below +5.0 for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has weakened to -38.7 and remains below its four-week average; while transit stays below -35, reduced station footfall suppresses spontaneous retail trips, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -35 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks while TRANSIT stays below -35.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL above +20 signals stay-at-home directives; while this regime persists, retail trips are curtailed, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL remains above +20.

mechanism_narrative: Low PARKS combined with weak TRANSIT indicates both outdoor and transit-based discretionary trips are suppressed; the interaction reduces retail-and-recreation footfall, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks while PARKS is below -40 and TRANSIT is below -35.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of WORKPLACES below -35 and RESIDENTIAL above +20 signals a work-from-home regime that removes weekday retail circuits, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next week while WORKPLACES is below -35 and RESIDENTIAL is above +20.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has fallen to +1.1; if it crosses below zero, essential-mobility contraction broadens into retail, and RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next week while GROCERY_PHARM falls below 0.0.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES stop making new four-week lows and hold above -40, the mobility floor is established; retail trips then recover modestly over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT above -40 and WORKPLACES above -40 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than last 28-day mean when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both hold above -40 for two weeks.
